Name: Cinnabunny (Pet Cinnamon Roll)
Author: cozysweetpotato
Description:
A delicious cinnamon roll bunny rabbit to keep you company with its sweet freshly baked aroma ♡

This mod was made possible because of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25216?tab=description]this mod[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/149208243]NexusModsUser92384[/url] so thank you so much for making a pet rabbit mod!! ♡

I am using the lovely Faedew reshade by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/11471909]rosenfey[/url] in my screenshots as well as Wildflower Grass Field by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty. 

[/url]This mod is part of a larger series I plan to make for cottage witches! The series will have a cozy cottagecore witchy vibe. 

Content Patcher required

I hope you enjoy this mod and thank you for your support ♡

Mod inspired by cinnamon roll bunny art including this lovely piece by [url=https://www.instagram.com/afternoon_fika/]AfternoonFika[/url]﻿
